title: Restaurant Complaint
subtitle: Sending a dish back politely — for English learners

sentences.en: Excuse me, could I speak to you for a moment about my order?
sentences.target: Excuse me, could I speak to you for a moment about my order?

sentences.en: Of course. Is something wrong with your meal?
sentences.target: Of course. Is something wrong with your meal?

sentences.en: I asked for the chicken well-done, but it's still pink in the middle.
sentences.target: I asked for the chicken well-done, but it's still pink in the middle.

sentences.en: I'm so sorry about that. Let me take it back to the kitchen right away.
sentences.target: I'm so sorry about that. Let me take it back to the kitchen right away.

sentences.en: Also, the salad was supposed to come without onions, but it has them.
sentences.target: Also, the salad was supposed to come without onions, but it has them.

sentences.en: I apologize — I'll have a fresh one made for you immediately.
sentences.target: I apologize — I'll have a fresh one made for you immediately.

sentences.en: Thank you. I'd really appreciate it if it didn't take too long.
sentences.target: Thank you. I'd really appreciate it if it didn't take too long.

sentences.en: Absolutely. As an apology, your drinks tonight will be on the house.
sentences.target: Absolutely. As an apology, your drinks tonight will be on the house.

sentences.en: That's very kind of you. Thank you for handling this so well.
sentences.target: That's very kind of you. Thank you for handling this so well.

sentences.en: It's the least we can do. I'll bring everything out in about ten minutes.
